name: Garden plot
notes: One of the 4 garden plots under the rock wall of the menu map (scn_menu places them, each reading its own variable, plot_1 to plot_4). It shows what the plot holds right now (0 soil, 1 seed, 2 sprout, 3 young plant, 4 budding plant, 5 full grown (golden flower), 6 HP UP ripe on the soil, 7 POWER UP ripe on the soil), and changes the moment that changes: picking up a ripe item turns it back into empty soil at once.
